# 1. Build the Signalling Pathways Track

```{r build_signalling_track}
# Cross-reference the six named Hallmark signalling processes against 
# the corresponding yes_apriori GO BP module. Module
# mapping is a manual, documented design choice (Section 3.2.17), not
# derived automatically.

hallmark_terms <- c(
  "HALLMARK_WNT_BETA_CATENIN_SIGNALING",
  "HALLMARK_COAGULATION",
  "HALLMARK_COMPLEMENT",
  "HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB",
  "HALLMARK_G2M_CHECKPOINT",
  "HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION"
)

module_lookup <- tibble::tribble(
  ~pathway,                                       ~GO_BP_module,
  "HALLMARK_WNT_BETA_CATENIN_SIGNALING",          "wnt_mesoderm_pluripotency",
  "HALLMARK_COAGULATION",                          "coagulation_hemostasis",
  "HALLMARK_COMPLEMENT",                           "immune_inflammatory_response",
  "HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB",              "immune_inflammatory_response",
  "HALLMARK_EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION",    "epithelial_mesenchymal_transition",
  "HALLMARK_G2M_CHECKPOINT",                       "NOT COVERED BY GO BP MODULES"
)

read_hallmark_sheet <- function(sheet_name, contrast_label) {
  read_excel("GSEA_Hallmark_common.xlsx", sheet = sheet_name) %>%
    dplyr::filter(pathway %in% hallmark_terms) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(contrast = contrast_label) %>%
    dplyr::select(pathway, contrast, NES, padj)
}

signalling_track <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  read_hallmark_sheet("eMPC_vs_iPSC", "eMPC_vs_iPSC"),
  read_hallmark_sheet("EC_vs_eMPC",   "EC_vs_eMPC"),
  read_hallmark_sheet("EC_vs_iPSC",   "EC_vs_iPSC")
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(module_lookup, by = "pathway") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(process = gsub("HALLMARK_", "", pathway)) %>%
  dplyr::select(process, GO_BP_module, contrast, NES, padj)

write_xlsx(list("signalling_track" = signalling_track), path = "signalling_track.xlsx")
cat("Exported signalling_track.xlsx —", nrow(signalling_track), "rows\n")
print(as.data.frame(signalling_track))

#The result is 18 as the Hallmark result is 6, and this runs across the 3 contrasts.
```

# 2. Transcription Factor Track (Read and Prepare)

```{r load_tf_data}
# TF evidence and trajectory tables are built and exported in
# TF_Track.Rmd. Read here rather than rebuilt.

evidence_table <- read_excel("TF_track_evidence_table.xlsx", sheet = "tf_evidence_table")
tf_trajectory  <- read_excel("TF_track_trajectory.xlsx", sheet = "tf_trajectory")
write.csv(le_all, "leading_edge_long_table.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("TF trajectory table loaded:", nrow(tf_trajectory), "TFs\n")
```

```{r build_tf_selection_table}

# Build the selection table used to decide which TFs enter the main
# figure. is_leading_edge is not included as a selection variable:
# all TFs in tf_trajectory already have leading-edge evidence.
# The 45 main TFs satisfy all three evidence criteria under the
# standard threshold, while the 7 broad-only TFs satisfy all three
# under the relaxed DEG threshold. Therefore, leading-edge membership
# does not discriminate among candidates at this stage.

tf_module_lookup <- le_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(gene %in% tf_trajectory$source) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(biological_module = paste(sort(unique(biological_category)), collapse = "; "),
                    .groups = "drop")

tf_selection_table <- tf_trajectory %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    evidence_table %>% dplyr::select(TF, n_evidence_types, n_significant_contrasts),
    by = c("source" = "TF")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(max_abs_activity = max(abs(c(eMPC_vs_iPSC, EC_vs_eMPC, EC_vs_iPSC)))) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::left_join(tf_module_lookup, by = c("source" = "gene")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    main_stage = dplyr::case_when(
      trajectory_class %in% c("eMPC_peak", "eMPC_trough") ~ "eMPC",
      trajectory_class == "monotonic_increase" ~ "EC",
      trajectory_class == "monotonic_decrease" ~ "iPSC",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    ),
    selected_main_figure = NA,  # populated below based on the finalized manual selection criteria
    reason = NA_character_
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    TF = source, n_evidence_types, n_significant_contrasts, max_abs_activity,
    trajectory_class, main_stage, biological_module,
    source_pool, selected_main_figure, reason
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_evidence_types), dplyr::desc(max_abs_activity))

write_xlsx(list("tf_selection_table" = tf_selection_table), path = "TF_selection_table.xlsx")
cat("Exported TF_selection_table.xlsx —", nrow(tf_selection_table), "TFs\n")
print(as.data.frame(tf_selection_table))
```
## 2.1. QC Stage Flag

```{r tf_stage_flag_qc}
tf_selection_table <- tf_selection_table %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    evidence_table %>% dplyr::select(TF, contrasts_significant),
    by = "TF"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    leg1_sig = grepl("eMPC_vs_iPSC", contrasts_significant),
    leg2_sig = grepl("EC_vs_eMPC", contrasts_significant),
    stage_flag = dplyr::case_when(
      !(trajectory_class %in% c("eMPC_peak", "eMPC_trough")) ~ NA_character_,
      leg1_sig & leg2_sig ~ NA_character_,
      leg2_sig & !leg1_sig ~ "eMPC_vs_iPSC leg not significant",
      leg1_sig & !leg2_sig ~ "EC_vs_eMPC leg not significant",
      TRUE ~ "neither leg significant"
    )
  )
```

## 2.2. Main stage Re-definition

```{r tf_main_stage_corrected}
# eMPC_peak: by construction eMPC exceeds both flanks — main_stage =
# "eMPC" needs no further check. eMPC_trough is the opposite case:
# eMPC is where activity is LOWEST, so "where is this TF most active"
# requires comparing the two flanks (EC_vs_iPSC) instead of defaulting
# to eMPC. leg3_sig flags whether that comparison itself is
# statistically supported.

tf_selection_table <- tf_selection_table %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    tf_trajectory %>% dplyr::select(source, EC_vs_iPSC),
    by = c("TF" = "source")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    leg3_sig = grepl("EC_vs_iPSC", contrasts_significant),
    main_stage = dplyr::case_when(
      trajectory_class == "monotonic_increase" ~ "EC",
      trajectory_class == "monotonic_decrease" ~ "iPSC",
      trajectory_class == "eMPC_peak" ~ "eMPC",
      trajectory_class == "eMPC_trough" & EC_vs_iPSC > 0 ~ "EC",
      trajectory_class == "eMPC_trough" & EC_vs_iPSC < 0 ~ "iPSC",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    trough_reassignment_flag = dplyr::if_else(
      trajectory_class == "eMPC_trough" & !leg3_sig,
      "EC_vs_iPSC not significant — reassignment based on sign only",
      NA_character_
    )
  )

cat("=== main_stage reassignment check (eMPC_trough only) ===\n")
tf_selection_table %>%
  dplyr::filter(source_pool == "main", trajectory_class == "eMPC_trough") %>%
  dplyr::count(main_stage, trough_reassignment_flag)
```

## 2.3. Inspect Updated TF Candidates

```{r inspect_updated_tf_candidates}

tf_selection_table %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    main_stage,
    dplyr::desc(n_significant_contrasts),
    dplyr::desc(max_abs_activity)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    TF,
    source_pool,
    main_stage,
    trajectory_class,
    n_significant_contrasts,
    max_abs_activity,
    biological_module
  ) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```


# 3. Cellular Functions Track (Read and Prepare)

```{r load_module_scores}
# Module scores (mean z-score per module per sample) already computed
# in Molecular_Signatures.Rmd, Section 10.

module_scores <- read_excel("module_scores_by_sample.xlsx")
cat("Module scores loaded:", nrow(module_scores), "modules,", ncol(module_scores) - 1, "samples\n")
```

# 4. Apply TF Selection Criteria for the Main Figure

```{r apply_tf_selection}
# Main-figure selection: 1-2 representative TFs per main_stage x
# dominant biological theme, chosen to maximise n_significant_contrasts
# and max_abs_activity while avoiding redundant TFs from the same
# biological block (e.g. only one of ZEB1/ZEB2/SNAI1/SNAI2 for EMT).
# NOTCH1 is retained despite not ranking among the strongest TFs by
# activity magnitude, given its central, highly pleiotropic role across
# 11 biological modules. This is a manually curated selection,
# not an automated ranking — documented explicitly here rather than
# derived by a formula, consistent with the reasoning in Section 3
# (TF_Track.Rmd) that a pure numerical ranking risks biasing the
# figure toward a single contrast or function.

selected_tfs <- tibble::tribble(
  ~TF,      ~reason,
  "ZEB2",    "EC-associated; EMT block representative (avoids redundancy with ZEB1/SNAI1/SNAI2)",
  "RELA",    "EC-associated; together with NFKB1, represents the canonical NF-kB heterodimer (RelA/p50) — both subunits activated at the EC stage",
  "SMAD3",   "EC-associated; TGF-beta/BMP block representative",
  "GATA2",   "EC-associated; endothelial/vascular identity",
  "NOTCH1",  "EC-associated; central pleiotropic regulator (11 biological modules), retained despite modest per-contrast significance relative to other EC candidates",
  "LEF1",    "eMPC-associated (eMPC_peak); canonical WNT effector",
  "NFKB1",   "EC-associated (eMPC_trough, reassigned to EC because inferred activity is higher in EC than in iPSC); together with RELA, represents the canonical NF-kB heterodimer (RelA/p50) — both subunits activated at the EC stage",
  "NR2F2",   "eMPC-associated (eMPC_peak); arterial-venous specification (COUP-TFII)",
  "HEY1",    "iPSC-associated (monotonic_decrease); retained over higher-evidence alternatives (e.g. HHEX) for its broader leading-edge integration across Notch signalling, endothelium development and blood vessel morphogenesis"
)

tf_selection_table <- tf_selection_table %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    selected_main_figure = TF %in% selected_tfs$TF,
    reason = selected_tfs$reason[match(TF, selected_tfs$TF)]
  )

write_xlsx(list("tf_selection_table" = tf_selection_table), path = "TF_selection_table.xlsx")

cat("Total candidate TFs (full table, exported):", nrow(tf_selection_table), "\n")
cat("  - marked TRUE (main figure):", sum(tf_selection_table$selected_main_figure), "\n")
cat("  - marked FALSE (documented only, not in main figure):", sum(!tf_selection_table$selected_main_figure), "\n")
```

# 5. Prepare Data for the Integrated Figure

```{r prepare_signalling_stage}
# Assign each signaling process to a main_stage using the sign of the
# Hallmark NES in the two sequential contrasts (eMPC_vs_iPSC and
# EC_vs_eMPC), following the same stage-assignment rule used for the
# TF track (Section 2.2):
#   +/+ -> EC      (monotonic increase)
#   -/- -> iPSC    (monotonic decrease)
#   +/- -> eMPC    (maximum at eMPC)
#   -/+ -> minimum at eMPC, so the process is reassigned to EC or iPSC
#          according to the sign of the EC_vs_iPSC NES
# Statistical significance is not used for stage assignment; padj values
# are kept in signalling_track for interpretation.

signalling_wide <- signalling_track %>%
  dplyr::select(process, contrast, NES) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = contrast, values_from = NES)

signalling_stage <- signalling_wide %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    main_stage = dplyr::case_when(
      eMPC_vs_iPSC > 0 & EC_vs_eMPC < 0 ~ "eMPC",
      eMPC_vs_iPSC < 0 & EC_vs_eMPC > 0 & EC_vs_iPSC > 0 ~ "EC",
      eMPC_vs_iPSC < 0 & EC_vs_eMPC > 0 & EC_vs_iPSC < 0 ~ "iPSC",
      eMPC_vs_iPSC > 0 & EC_vs_eMPC > 0 ~ "EC",
      eMPC_vs_iPSC < 0 & EC_vs_eMPC < 0 ~ "iPSC",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    ),
    track = "Signaling Pathways",
    label = process
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(track, label, main_stage)

print(signalling_stage)
```

```{r prepare_cellular_functions_stage}
# Assign each biological module to a main_stage, using the stage with
# the highest mean module z-score across its three replicates.

module_scores_long <- module_scores %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-1, names_to = "sample", values_to = "z_score") %>%
  dplyr::rename(module = 1) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(stage = dplyr::case_when(
    grepl("iPSC", sample) ~ "iPSC",
    grepl("eMPC", sample) ~ "eMPC",
    grepl("EC", sample)   ~ "EC"
  ))

cellular_functions_stage <- module_scores_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(module, stage) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_z = mean(z_score), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(module) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(mean_z, n = 1) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    track = "Cellular Functions",
    label = module,
    main_stage = stage
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(track, label, main_stage)

print(cellular_functions_stage)
```

```{r prepare_tf_stage}
# TF track: only the 9 TFs selected for the main figure.

tf_stage <- tf_selection_table %>%
  dplyr::filter(selected_main_figure) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(track = "Transcription Factors", label = TF) %>%
  dplyr::select(track, label, main_stage)

print(tf_stage)
```

# 6. Integrated Timeline Figure

```{r finalize_tf_selection}
# Add HIPK2 as a second iPSC-associated TF alongside HEY1: HIPK2 has
# higher n_significant_contrasts and max_abs_activity among
# iPSC-associated (monotonic_decrease) candidates, while HEY1 is
# retained for its established narrative relevance (Notch effector,
# discussed elsewhere in the thesis). Both justifications are recorded
# explicitly rather than favouring one candidate silently.

tf_selection_table <- tf_selection_table %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    selected_main_figure = dplyr::if_else(TF == "HIPK2", TRUE, selected_main_figure),
    reason = dplyr::if_else(TF == "HIPK2",
      "iPSC-associated (monotonic_decrease); highest max_abs_activity among the main monotonic-decrease TFs, added alongside HEY1, which was retained for its broader leading-edge integration and Notch-related biological relevance",
      reason)
  )

write_xlsx(list("tf_selection_table" = tf_selection_table), path = "TF_selection_table.xlsx")
cat("TFs selected for main figure:", sum(tf_selection_table$selected_main_figure), "\n")
```

```{r prepare_track_data}
# Prepare the three tracks in their final form, with the correct track
# names assigned from the start.

tf_stage <- tf_selection_table %>%
  dplyr::filter(selected_main_figure) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(track = "Transcription Factors", label = TF) %>%
  dplyr::select(track, label, main_stage)

# Same stage-assignment rule as in Section 5 (and as the TF track,
# Section 2.2), including reassignment of -/+ (minimum at eMPC) patterns.
signalling_stage <- signalling_wide %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    main_stage = dplyr::case_when(
      eMPC_vs_iPSC > 0 & EC_vs_eMPC < 0 ~ "eMPC",
      eMPC_vs_iPSC < 0 & EC_vs_eMPC > 0 & EC_vs_iPSC > 0 ~ "EC",
      eMPC_vs_iPSC < 0 & EC_vs_eMPC > 0 & EC_vs_iPSC < 0 ~ "iPSC",
      eMPC_vs_iPSC > 0 & EC_vs_eMPC > 0 ~ "EC",
      eMPC_vs_iPSC < 0 & EC_vs_eMPC < 0 ~ "iPSC",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    ),
    track = "Signaling / Regulatory Programs",
    label = process
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(track, label, main_stage)

cellular_functions_stage <- module_scores_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(module, stage) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(mean_z = mean(z_score), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(module) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(mean_z, n = 1) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(track = "Cellular Functions", label = module, main_stage = stage) %>%
  dplyr::select(track, label, main_stage)

cat("TF track:", nrow(tf_stage), "| Signaling track:", nrow(signalling_stage),
    "| Cellular Functions track:", nrow(cellular_functions_stage), "\n")
```

```{r combine_timeline_data}
timeline_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(tf_stage, signalling_stage, cellular_functions_stage) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    track = factor(track, levels = c("Transcription Factors", "Signaling / Regulatory Programs", "Cellular Functions")),
    main_stage = factor(main_stage, levels = c("iPSC", "eMPC", "EC"))
  )

cat("Timeline data rows:", nrow(timeline_data), "\n")
```

```{r draw_timeline, fig.width=12, fig.height=11}
library(patchwork)
library(ggh4x)

# Cleans Hallmark (SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE) and GO BP (lowercase) labels
# into Title Case, with British-to-American spelling correction
# (Signalling -> Signaling), consistent with the rest of the thesis.

clean_label <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("_", " ", x)
  x <- gsub("Signalling", "Signaling", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  tools::toTitleCase(tolower(x))
}

# Scientific-notation overrides applied after clean_label(): fixes
# acronym capitalization (G2M, not G2m) and Greek-letter/subscript
# notation that a generic Title Case function cannot produce correctly.
hallmark_overrides <- c(
  "G2m Checkpoint"          = "G2M Checkpoint",
  "Tnfa Signaling via Nfkb" = "TNF\u03b1 Signaling via NF-\u03baB"
)

# Manual short labels for on-figure display; full names are given in
# the figure caption.
short_label_map <- c(
  "Extracellular Matrix Organization / Remodelling" = "ECM Organization / Remodelling",
  "VEGF Signaling and Endothelial Response"         = "VEGF / Endothelial Response",
  "Cardiovascular and Endocardial Development"      = "Cardiovascular Development",
  "Cell Adhesion and Cell-Matrix Interaction"        = "Cell-Matrix Adhesion",
  "Vascular Homeostasis / Fluid Regulation"          = "Vascular Homeostasis",
  "Embryonic Patterning and Morphogenesis"           = "Embryonic Patterning"
)

track_bg_colors <- c(
  "Transcription Factors"           = "#EAF2F8",
  "Signaling / Regulatory Programs" = "#FDF2E9",
  "Cellular Functions"              = "#EAFAF1"
)

stage_colors <- c("iPSC" = "#4C72B0", "eMPC" = "#DD8452", "EC" = "#C44E52")

# Manual panel height ratios (not proportional to item count), so
# Cellular Functions (15 modules) does not visually dominate the
# figure over the smaller TF and Signaling tracks.
panel_heights <- c("Transcription Factors" = 1, "Signaling / Regulatory Programs" = 1,
                    "Cellular Functions" = 1.4)

timeline_positioned <- timeline_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    label = dplyr::case_when(
      track == "Signaling / Regulatory Programs" ~ dplyr::recode(clean_label(label), !!!hallmark_overrides),
      track == "Cellular Functions"              ~ clean_label(tools::toTitleCase(label)),
      TRUE ~ label
    ),
    label = dplyr::recode(label, !!!short_label_map)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(track, main_stage, label) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(track, main_stage) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(y_pos = dplyr::row_number()) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(track) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(y_pos = max(y_pos) - y_pos + 1,
                stage_hex = stage_colors[as.character(main_stage)]) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

bg_data <- data.frame(
  track = factor(names(track_bg_colors), levels = levels(timeline_positioned$track)),
  fill_hex = unname(track_bg_colors)
)

main_plot <- ggplot(timeline_positioned, aes(x = main_stage, y = y_pos)) +
  geom_rect(data = bg_data, aes(fill = I(fill_hex)),
            xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1:3, color = "gray70", linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_label(aes(label = label, fill = I(stage_hex)), color = "white", fontface = "bold",
             size = 3, linewidth = 0, label.padding = unit(0.25, "lines")) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(track), scales = "free_y", space = "free", switch = "y") +
  ggh4x::force_panelsizes(rows = panel_heights[levels(timeline_positioned$track)]) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, position = "top") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = "Integrated Differentiation Timeline") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold", size = 10),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.6, "lines"),
    axis.text.x.top = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 2, l = 10)
  )

arrow_plot <- ggplot(data.frame(x = 1, xend = 3, y = 0, yend = 0),
                      aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = yend)) +
  geom_segment(arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm"), type = "closed"),
               linewidth = 1.2, color = "gray30") +
  geom_segment(data = data.frame(x = 1:3, y = -0.15, yend = 0.15),
               aes(x = x, xend = x, y = y, yend = yend),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "gray30", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = 2, y = -0.5, label = "Differentiation trajectory",
           fontface = "italic", size = 3.5, color = "gray30") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.7, 3.3)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.7, 0.3)) +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 10, b = 5, l = 10))

main_plot / arrow_plot + patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(1, 0.04))
```
